title: fix(service-knowledge)!: retire the knowledge field gate's title arm behind a per-source recipe proof
body:
Fixes #37467

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches the knowledge field gate or its refusals (`git grep` of `skills/objectstack-ai` for the gate, the display field and `KNOWLEDGE_REBUILD_REQUIRED`: 0 hits)

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：知识检索的权限过滤不再额外检查名为“标题”的旧字段；只有当对象同时有“标题”字段和另一个显示字段、且该知识源的索引还没按当前方式完整重建过时，非系统用户检索该源会被告知“需要重建”，重建完成后恢复正常。
- 为什么做：知识检索收口（知识库检索按调用者权限过滤）的遗留清理——旧索引兼容分支退役，改为按每个知识源确认索引已按当前方式建成。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是上述少数知识源在重建完成前检索不到内容（会明确报“需要重建”），不会泄露无权字段；改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **The field gate's `title` arm is gone** (`knowledge-source-admission.ts`, `servedFieldsOf`). The gate now asks about exactly what a document carries under the current recipe: each `content` and `metadataFields` member and the display field (`documentTitleField`), less the fields an index never carries.
- **Per-source proof at search time.** A new predicate, `mayServeEarlierRuleTitle`, names the sources where the retired arm mattered: the object declares a field named `title` (or its fields cannot be enumerated), the index may carry it, and the source does not serve it. For a non-system caller, such a source is searched only when its adapter's `indexStatus` reports the fingerprint AND the recipe hash `planIndex` computes now (`KnowledgeService.unprovenIndex`, called from `planSearches`). The recipe hash names the title rule (ADR-0161 K7) and is recorded only by `completeBuild`, at the end of a complete build.
- **Without the proof the source is refused, never served through the old arm**: it is named in `refused` as `KNOWLEDGE_REBUILD_REQUIRED` / 409 (the code `@objectstack/service-knowledge` already holds in the error-code ledger), the operator is told why at `warn`, and a search where it was the only source refuses whole, as an adapter refusal does. An adapter with no `indexStatus`, or one that throws, is not proven (fails closed). The boot's build pass, a reload and `os knowledge rebuild` build it; the search never starts a build.
- **Every other source pays nothing**: no extra read when the object declares no `title`, its display field is `title`, `title` is credential-class or `internal`, or the source serves `title` itself.
- **Save door (ADR-0161 K4 guard two)**: the same `servedFieldsOf` judges a save, so an author no longer needs to query a `title` field the source never indexes. This is the `yes` half of the declaration; the display field is still asked.
- `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`: the two paragraphs that described the arm now describe the proof and the refusal.

Why a matching recipe hash proves there is no earlier-rule title in the index: the recipe hash landed in `9981f27d96` (#37337), after the display-field title rule in `039b2884d4` (#37301), so every recorded `rh1` hash was written by code that already read the display field; a complete build rewrites each document whose `docHash` changed (the hash covers `title`) and purges every document it did not walk.

## Tests

`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/__tests__/knowledge-source-admission.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe` in the existing harness plus one save-door case:

- proven index: a caller who may not query `title` is served (the arm is gone); `indexStatus` read once;
- unproven, five ways (no `indexStatus`; no recipe hash; another recipe hash; another fingerprint; `indexStatus` throws): refused with `code` `KNOWLEDGE_REBUILD_REQUIRED` and `status` 409 for a caller who may and one who may not query `title`, adapter never asked to search, the system context still served;
- an unproven source beside a searchable one: named in `refused`, the other answers;
- sources where the arm never mattered are searched with no `indexStatus` read;
- rebuilt: refused, then `rebuildSource` completes, `readIndexState` reads `current`, and the source is served;
- reverse pins on a proven index: the display field, a `content` field and a `metadataFields` field the caller may not query each still refuse the source; on an unproven index a stored hit carrying an earlier-rule title never reaches the caller;
- `mayServeEarlierRuleTitle` table (7 cases); save door: hidden `title` admitted, hidden display field refused `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 naming `name`.

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` in `packages/services/service-knowledge` at `dc38e8206f`: Test Files 17 passed (17), Tests 548 passed (548).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0, "0 file(s) / 0 error(s)".
- Ablation, one on-disk mutation each, restored with `git checkout HEAD -- src` and a clean `git status` between: arm restored, 12 red; proof skipped, 9 red; recipe hash not compared, 4 red; fingerprint not compared, 1 red; predicate always true, 22 red; withheld `title` ignored, 1 red; served-field check removed, 15 red (including the three proven-index reverse pins).
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 101 families) run locally and reconciled with `--ran`: 98 exit 0, 3 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite not met: `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:type-check-debt` read built output of packages this card does not build). `check:error-code-casing` also run: exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance 1, per-source proof at search time: `unprovenIndex` reads the adapter's `indexStatus` against `planIndex`'s fingerprint and recipe hash, no new contract member and no stored state. Read on every search that needs it, never cached (another node may rebuild or drop the index); only sources where the arm mattered pay the read.
- Card acceptance 2: arm removed; a source without the proof is refused and built by the existing boot pass, reload and operator rebuild. Tests cover both.
- Card acceptance 3: no other arm changed; reverse pins above.
- The claim's `:178` is not the arm: `documentTitleField` answering `title` for an object with no definition is the current assembly rule (assembly reads `title` there too), so the gate keeps asking about it. Only `:278` was the arm.
- Narrowing, declared for the seat: until a complete build has completed, a qualifying source is refused (memory adapter: from each boot until the boot build completes; any adapter: after a recipe change until its rebuild completes), and on an adapter with no `indexStatus` or no `completeBuild` it stays refused.

## Verification

Read first: `knowledge-service.ts` `planSearches` and `unprovenIndex` (the refusal and the comparison), then `knowledge-source-admission.ts` `mayServeEarlierRuleTitle` (which sources pay the read).

Two minutes: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/knowledge-source-admission.test.ts` shows 62 passed, including the `field gate — the earlier title rule` block.
